scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @nolt/api" "npm run dev -w @nolt/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run contracts:build && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run contracts:build && npm run build -w @nolt/api && npm run build -w @nolt/web
scripts.api:generate: npm run build -w @nolt/api && node apps/api/dist/export-openapi.js && openapi-typescript docs/api/openapi.json -o packages/api-client/src/schema.d.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages/form-schemas/src packages/api-client/src/index.ts tests scripts database/*.ts package.json tsconfig*.json playwright.config.ts .github/workflows/checks.yml
